# HIVY - Place for Celebrations

> Best romantic celebration venue in Surat, Gujarat, India. Private rooftop candlelight dinners, birthday surprises, anniversary celebrations, marriage proposals, and intimate date nights. 100% couples-only, 4.9★ rated.

## About HIVY

HIVY - Place for Celebrations is Surat's premier private romantic celebration venue located at 252/253, 2nd Floor, The Boulevard, Near Pratham Circle, Galleria Street, Green City Road, Adajan, Pal Gam, Surat, Gujarat 394510.

We specialize in creating unforgettable romantic experiences for couples:
- Candlelight Dinners
- Birthday Surprise Celebrations
- Anniversary Celebrations (1st, 5th, 10th, 25th, 50th, and all milestones)
- Marriage Proposals & Ring Ceremonies
- Pre-Wedding Photoshoots
- Valentine's Day Specials
- Surprise Date Nights
- Baby Moment Celebrations (Pregnancy Announcements)

## Key Facts

- **Location**: Surat, Gujarat, India
